findings.title: Tool list changes between consecutive polls
findings.detail: Two back-to-back tools/list calls returned different results (changed: chain_gas_price). A server that mutates its own tool set mid-session can swap in poisoned instructions after review.
findings.remediation: Treat as untrusted; the tools you audit may not be the tools the model sees.
